transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As we begin our review of the proposed investment in the GreenBridge Renewable Infrastructure Credit Fund, I'd like to follow our standard pre-commitment process. Before we move to a vote, I'm asking portfolio risk, fund operations, and compliance to each report any relevant conditions or concerns you've identified. The investment window closes on June 30, 2026, so we have time to do this properly, but I want to make sure we hear from all three functions before any decision is made. Who would like to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I'd like to report a portfolio risk condition. This morning I recalculated our firm's existing exposure to infrastructure credit, and based on the updated exposure file I received today — which hasn't yet been added to the committee packet — portfolio policy permits no more than a $6,500,000 additional commitment to GreenBridge. Any commitment above that level would breach our portfolio concentration limits.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I have a fund operations condition to report. I confirmed with GreenBridge's administrator this week that the first capital draw on this commitment may not exceed $1,500,000 and requires 10 business days' advance notice. The administrator's confirmation is still in my operations inbox.
